t: This is the Royal Opera House in Covent Garden, the main home of The Royal Opera, The Royal Ballet and the Orchestra of the Royal Opera House. Many people simply call it Covent Garden. The building you see is the third theatre on this site, and it opened in 1858. Its architect was Edward Middleton Barry. The singer Martha Ray, who lived in the Georgian era and was known for her talent and her looks, died here. Her father was a corsetmaker, and she came to the attention of his patrons.
